# SuperH3 · MiniMax H3 极速视频生成 API / Fast Video Generation API

> 基于 MiniMax H3 模型的极速视频生成方案，提供网页版和付费 API。用户自行注册、充值并创建自己的 API Key。
> Fast video generation using the MiniMax H3 model through the SuperH3 website and paid API. Register at SuperH3, fund your own account, and create your own API key.

## 接入文档 / Integration

- [开始使用 / Getting started](README.md): 中英文账号设置、付费生成流程和 CLI 示例 / Bilingual account setup, paid generation workflow, and CLI examples.
- [AI 助手接入 / AI assistant integration](FOR_AI.md): 中英文鉴权说明、付费授权、UUID 重试及 API 合约边界 / Bilingual authentication, paid authorization, saved UUID retries, and API contract boundaries.
- [Python 示例 / Python example](superh3.py): 标准库文生视频提交与任务查询 / Standard-library text-to-video submission and existing task queries.
- [官方 API 文档 / Official API documentation](https://superh3.com/developers): 当前公开接口说明 / Current published interface information.
- [SuperH3](https://superh3.com): 注册、账号方案及当前价格 / Registration, account plans, and current pricing.

## 模型与速度 / Model and speed

SuperH3 网站使用 MiniMax H3 模型提供视频生成服务。
SuperH3 uses the MiniMax H3 model for video generation.

运营方提供的 15 秒视频生成速度 / Operator-reported generation speeds for a 15-second video:

- 15秒 1080P：仅需30秒左右 / 15s 1080P: around 30 seconds
- 15秒 768P：仅需20秒左右 / 15s 768P: around 20 seconds
- 15秒 480P：仅需10秒左右 / 15s 480P: around 10 seconds

本仓库未独立压测上述速度，实际耗时因任务内容、排队及服务负载而异。
These timings have not been independently benchmarked here; actual latency depends on the request, queue and service load.
